steps.title: Daily Site Report
steps.ask: I want to fill today's daily site report.
fill: Okay, let's start a daily report. This one's for Dixie Road and Mayfield Road, on the Dixie corridor site. It was a day shift, and the supervisor is Gurpreet Sandhu.
On item C-15 a today, we had one open-cut foreman, four open-cut labourers and two pipelayers. They each put in ten hours.
On the same item, we had the 40 tonne excavator going, plus three granular trucks. Those ran ten hours each too.
And we got three hundred tonnes placed on C-15 a.
And we lost two hours this morning, waiting on Bell to locate a duct bank at station fourteen plus two-eighty.
Oh right, the weather. It was partly cloudy, twelve degrees.
